headline: State Park and Waterway Use Permits
reservation: Access to the lake is free, but Deep Creek Lake State Park requires a day-use fee. Boating requires a valid Maryland vessel registration or a temporary permit; dock usage is often restricted to private owners or specific marinas. Verify seasonal dock removal dates with the DNR.

days.title: Ancient Hemlocks and Waterfalls

stops.name: Swallow Falls State Park
stops.detail: Walk the Canyon Trail to see Muddy Creek Falls and old-growth forests.

stops.name: Herrington Manor State Park
stops.detail: Enjoy a quieter lakeside setting for paddleboarding or birdwatching.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for mountain road transit; conditions vary
days.note: Swallow Falls can be slippery after rain; wear boots with excellent grip.

days.title: Lake Exploration and Discovery
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the State Park Ramp

stops.name: Deep Creek Lake State Park
stops.detail: Visit the Discovery Center to see live birds of prey and learn about local ecology.

stops.name: McHenry Cove
stops.detail: Rent a pontoon or kayak to explore the northern reaches of the lake.

days.driving: Local transfers under 20 minutes; boat speeds regulated
days.note: Check wind forecasts before taking small watercraft into the main channel.

days.title: Mountain Thrills and Historic Towns

stops.name: Wisp Resort Mountain Coaster
stops.detail: Descend the mountain through the trees on a gravity-driven coaster.

stops.name: Oakland Historic District
stops.detail: Tour the 1884 Train Station and local museums in this gateway town.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes for regional travel; conditions vary
days.note: The mountain coaster and resort activities are subject to seasonal maintenance closures.

intel.title: State Park Beach Lots
intel.text: The main parking area at Deep Creek Lake State Park fills quickly on summer weekends. Arrive before mid-morning to secure a spot near the swimming beach and boat ramps.

intel.title: Mountain Terrain Obstructions
intel.text: Signal is strong in McHenry but becomes spotty in the dense hemlock groves of Swallow Falls and the southern Swanton area. Offline navigation is recommended for finding remote trailheads.

intel.title: Marine and Roadside Fuel
intel.text: Roadside stations are concentrated in McHenry and Oakland. On-water marine fuel is available at select marinas but operates on seasonal hours; check availability before long lake excursions.

intel.title: Fall Foliage Peak
intel.text: Peak colors typically arrive in early to mid-October, earlier than the Maryland coast. Expect increased traffic on US-219 during these weekends and book lodging months in advance.

intel.title: Lake Buffer Zone
intel.text: The shoreline is managed by the State of Maryland; do not cross private docks to access the water. Use designated public access points at the State Park or commercial marinas.

plan.arrival: Pickup rental at Morgantown (MGW) or Pittsburgh (PIT). Drive to McHenry to stock up at the local grocery stores before heading to your lakeside rental or glamping site.
plan.vehicle: A standard car is sufficient for main roads, but 4WD is strongly recommended for winter visits or steep cabin driveways; check local winter tire requirements.
plan.goldenHour: Glendale Bridge; note that sunset light reflects off the water beautifully, but late-season mountain fog can obscure views.
